style: The current Sushi Loop native family: warm softly beveled crafted materials, restrained surface wear, local dimensional shading and readable chunky silhouettes. Target a compact battered mustard armchair with torn left arm, seat tear/stuffing, one puffy sagged back and short feet.

source.scene: Inspect actual source asset root/scene; avoid unrelated active scenes

target.provenance: imagegen-builtin; camera drift in target is aesthetic only, fixed source camera wins

capture.registration: Preserve source camera matrix, ortho/pixel aspect/shift. New physical model fits declared footprint; no alpha fitting or per-view camera changes.

allowed: Derive a new whole-object furniture variant from source; rebuild meshes and nonfunctional forms to frozen target
Change source footprint to declared new footprint intentionally
Replace major structure/part counts and palette to the frozen target; keep recognizable abandoned furniture role
locked: Source camera/projection, source frame/root/scale and consistent render settings across four directions
Physical horizontal geometry stays inside new footprint; ground contact at z=0; no external loose debris
Real editable native geometry only; no target-facing cards/paint-over runtime images
No changes to original production library, original object or unrelated shared assets
modelingPolicy.interpretation: This is an authorized new model variant from an existing source, not a reskin forced to retain old sofa/shelf proportions. Target viewpoint drift does not override measured registration.

constraints.lighting: Reuse source equal broad horizontal fills and overhead; no ground plane or directional cast ground shadow. Retain current material family.
constraints.resources: Pack candidate resources or bind exact external closure; original backup remains untouched
constraints.deliveryScope: Prototype source/model and four static native world facings, same images reused for alpha-fitted gallery/clearance previews. CSS selected/clear/fade are consumers. Native animation and Godot integration are deferred until UI approval, original assets untouched.

consumers: Whole-object clearance preview measured alpha bounds, uniform scaling
Dense trash-field phone assembly at 128 logical units/cell scaled to 390/7px

qualityCriteria.basis: Independent inspection of original snapshot, frozen ImageGen target, source constraints and authorized variant freedom.

shapeVolume: Read immediately as one compact upholstered armchair: one thick back, one seat, two broad arms and short feet; avoid residual three-seat sofa proportions.

Use softly beveled/rounded substantial cushions with useful separation between back, seat, arms and base. Broad asymmetric sag or depression makes the back feel worn, without looking accidentally pinched or broken.
Preserve a coherent furniture silhouette in all N/E/S/W native facings. Unseen target sides should be plausible and belong to the same chair; no invented demand for identical damage on every side.
color: Main upholstery is visibly mustard/golden yellow with warm ochre/brown shaded planes. Pale cream stuffing and warm brown exposed structure/feet remain distinct from upholstery.
Wear/stains are restrained low-contrast variation rather than dense mottling or black dirt; mustard identity persists across all directions under the fixed lighting.
lightingHighlights: Broad gentle highlights and local self shading reveal cushion roundness, tears and structural depth. Recesses remain readable rather than featureless black patches.
No blown white highlights, glossy plastic sheen, directional cast ground shadow, halo fringe or view-specific relighting.
materialDetail: Upholstery feels soft and crafted through rounded edges, restrained surface variation and purposeful seam/piping cues.

The viewer-left arm in its front-facing view has a coherent substantial torn region showing inner brown structure and irregular folded or torn mustard fabric edges; avoid a flat painted decal or detached scraps.
Seat damage is a clear slit/opening with a small attached cluster of pale stuffing. Integrate it with the cushion surface, with no floating blobs, impossible intersection or detached debris.
Purposeful native improvements are welcome; target stain positions, exact tear-edge outline and exact puffy fold topology need not be copied.
intendedSizeReadability: At the declared phone consumer scale (390/7 px per 128-unit cell), the chair remains an identifiable compact mustard chair with visible cushion/arm separation.

Front/top-visible damage and stuffing form useful contrast marks without dominating the silhouette or turning into stray noise. Required gallery/clearance previews remain clean after their declared uniform alpha fit.
Inspect the complete native facings, four-view-sheet and real phone-consumer preview; a magnified beauty view alone is insufficient.
artifactFree: No clipping, coplanar/z-fighting seams, broken unintended holes, abrupt dark seams, exposed primitive ends, detached pieces, merged muddy forms or defects that materially distract at native/intended size.
Transparent edges are clean over light/gray/dark backgrounds; no ground plane/shadow, target card/impostor or image paint-over.

technicalLocks: Editable native Blender geometry and materials, with the exact candidate .blend and reproducible capture recipe/settings.
N/E/S/W captures from one fixed source camera matrix, ortho/pixel aspect/shift and common render setup; 896x1152 source frame, logical 448x576, root [224,352], source scale 2 and cell size 128.
Ground contact z=0, all physical horizontal geometry inside [-0.5,0.5] x [-0.5,0.5], maximum height 1.5, no external loose debris. Bounds must come from native validation, not guessed from pixels.
No per-view alpha fitting/recoloring/camera changes in native sprites. Declared consumer fits must use the same exact native images with uniform scale.
Reuse source equal broad horizontal fills/overhead and family shading; no ground plane or directional ground cast shadow.
Original production library/source and unrelated assets stay untouched; candidate dependencies are packed or bound exactly.
evidenceAndDecision: Before review, coordinator freezes these criteria into brief.qualityCriteria. Same bar applies to all rounds.
Exact immutable packet must bind .blend, all N/E/S/W images, validation, recipe/settings, four-view-sheet and phone-consumer previews; verify hashes before approval.
Review all actual native/consumer pixels at native and phone size and compare with the original and fixed target. Required supplemental views are not established by the single target.

Missing packaging/native proof is needs_evidence; visible defects are revise. Approval requires visible native improvement, passing locks and no material defects, with no universal numerical score cutoff.
Approval applies only to exact reviewed asset bytes and does not authorize production integration.
